offers_products.reason: Main offering is real estate ownership and financing of seniors housing; no manufactured goods or software sold.

offers_services.reason: REIT providing leases, mortgage financing, and SHOP-operated seniors housing; REITs count as services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Through SHOP, residents of senior living communities are the end customers paying for housing and care.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Triple-net leases, mortgage loans and joint ventures with senior housing and skilled nursing operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Rents, mortgage interest and monthly resident fees from long-term leases and residents recur continuously.

cyclical_demand.reason: Seniors housing and skilled nursing care are needs-based and rarely postponed in recessions.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay recurring monthly rent or resident fees rather than large one-time purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from owned properties, leases and financing, not its own staff's time; operators run care.

large_customers.reason: Customers are senior living residents and regional operators, mostly households and mid-sized operators rather than large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: REIT owning nearly 200 seniors housing and skilled nursing properties, requiring ongoing property investment.

notes: Mixed SHOP (resident-paying) and triple-net lease to operators; buyer type answers reflect both.
